messages:
maria-cs: Heads-up — Velociti usage has basically flatlined over the last 14 days. Active seats down ~42%. Renewal in ~45 days. They are on a Dedicated trial; procurement sniffing around. https://redwood.app/usage/velociti :eyes:
omar-csm: Thanks — any recent stakeholder changes? who is the exec sponsor now?
maria-cs: New PM (Aly) started 3 weeks ago, exec sponsor moved to a different BU. Aly is more focused on data platform than embedding workflows.
jenna-se: Noted. We saw a spike in support tickets about response latency and missing streaming context. Customer mentioned a demo from SparkShift last week.
liz-product: Could be a feature gap: our streaming/partial-output UX + lower tail latency wins for them. If they're piloting SparkShift, we should map feature checklist vs their acceptance criteria.
sam-sales: Procurement asked for a TCO comparison vs SparkShift yesterday. They want clear ROI for staying on Dedicated (cost + latency SLA). I can pull quoting details.
jenna-se: I can run a focussed enablement session for Aly + platform team. Also propose a 30-day pilot extension with tailored batching/quant config.
ops-bot: activity-alert — Velociti: 42% drop in daily-active-seats over 14d (threshold breached)
omar-csm: Maria can you paste the quick activity query you ran? want to validate times and whether it's a seat churn or daily cadence issue.
maria-cs: here's the query I used:
```
SELECT user_id, last_active_at
FROM usage_events
WHERE account_id = 'velociti'
  AND last_active_at > now() - interval '30 days';
```
jenna-se: I'll prepare a short deck: 1) latency + streaming demo 2) targeted enablement walkthrough 3) proposed 30-day extension + KPIs. Can someone own the procurement thread?
sam-sales: I’ll take procurement and draft the TCO slide. ping me the current committed rates for Dedicated.
liz-product: I'll map product gaps vs SparkShift and draft recommended quick wins we can implement in config (batching, kv cache tuning) — low-effort, high-impact.
omar-csm: Action items: Maria schedule a call w/ Aly + platform lead this week; Jenna deliver enablement; Sam draft TCO; Liz product gap doc. Can we land a decision checkpoint in 14 days?
maria-cs: Scheduling now. Proposed slot: Thu 10:00 PST. Invites sent.
jenna-se: I'll bring the demo env and a short runbook for ops to follow during trial.
sam-sales: I'll attach a one-pager for procurement to compare costs and SLA.
liz-product: Adding a quick checklist to the renewal playbook.
ops-bot: reminder -> add playbook tag: renewal-risk, account:velociti
maria-cs: Thanks team. I’ll update this thread after the call. :thumbsup:
